items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Mike Kaplan has befriended many a man in the music business... have had several occasions to have Mike and them over here.

ctx.x: Oh we said, talking about Mike Kaplan too, I think when the beat machine was on.

Mike Kaplan, Mike Kaplan has befriended many a man in the music business, he's been a very fine person. Played a good horn too, and I believe he can still play a horn. He does. And playing in the Shrine band there. Man, that day I marched up the street with Fez and Sash and didn't even belong to the Shrine yet. Now I've got it all. I've been, I'm a Shriner, Scottish Rite, York Rite, and have been quite active in Masonic work. I've been president of the Shrine Club here, Maraca Temple, and have had several…
It all ties in, I think. How did you get started on Cornette?
